title: I made a Co-op Cleaning Game with Claude Opus (online now)
author: TheAlgaeneer
selftext:
[https://schakka96.github.io/slowbroom/](https://schakka96.github.io/slowbroom/)

Hey Everyone =)  
This is SlowBroom, I game I made with the help of Claude. I first built it just for myself, to relax and do something satisfying. But Claude outdid itself and made it really fun and cute within the 8 hours that we worked on this together, and so I wanted to share. The goal it tidying up spaces and  it's also possible to chat with other people. Using some Opus max I managed to set up a multiplayer version via GitHub pages and free supabase as backend.  
I have very little programming and close to 0 game dev experience, so it was really rewarding seeing how far I could get with this project.  
There are 2 games here, one is a proper multiplayer where you sort leaves and things as little ants. The other one is a cleaning game.   
  
I play this while listening to an audiobook, or to just relax.  
The multiplayer is still a tiny bit laggy but it works well enough I'd say, as I just completed all 25 levels of the Ant minigame with a friend \^\^  
  
I tagged this as #Demo since it's anything but commercial. I don't earn from this stuff, it's just for fun. But if that's incorrect I will fix the flair.

Let me know what you all think of simple yet cleanly made web games like this!
